candidates.name: 几何精修
candidates.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one standalone production-quality square iOS app icon bitmap, 1024x1024. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the user's selected day-and-night icon for the meaningful-days and anniversary journal app Days Remember. Preserve its identity exactly: a golden sun disk in the upper-left of a bold ivory crescent moon, on a nearly black full-bleed background. Create a disciplined geometric refinement, not a new concept. Change only the proportions, optical alignment, spacing and edge finish. Reduce the sun slightly, give the crescent a stronger even body and gently softened tips, replace the knife-thin negative-space gap with a deliberate clear consistent black separation that survives at 40 pixels. Make the two shapes form one optically centered compact almost-circular emblem, occupying about 67 percent of the canvas width and height with generous balanced outer breathing room. The sun must remain a true simple circle; the moon hugs its right and lower side without touching the sun. Use exactly three perfectly flat solid colors: warm golden yellow, soft ivory, and near-black. Immaculate smooth edges and beautifully resolved curves, quiet confident premium editorial design. Opaque background extends to every edge and corner. No gradients, grain, textures, 3D, glow, drop shadow, embossing, outline, tiny details, extra dots, stars, rays, clock hands, heart, calendar, letters, text, border, inset rounded-square tile, phone, grid or comparison sheet. Return only this single refined square icon.
